prompt: Create a complete original 60-second instrumental cue in acoustic-folk style. Use fingerstyle guitar, mandolin, hand percussion. Tempo 114 BPM. Immediate short melodic hook and steady rhythm from the first beat. Keep this groove present until the final bar. In the final second, all instruments play one resolved tonic chord and stop together, allowing a short clean natural tail. This must end musically, with no fade and no abrupt unfinished phrase. No slow intro, silent gap, long outro or atmospheric wash. Pure instrumental performance: instruments exclusively. No human voice, speech, singing, humming, choir, vocal samples or crowd sounds anywhere.

description.en: An upbeat and positive acoustic instrumental track featuring a bright guitar melody, steady drums, and a warm bassline. It evokes a cheerful and lighthearted mood.
description.zh: 一首欢快积极的原声器乐曲，以明亮的吉他旋律、稳定的鼓点和温暖的贝斯线为特色。营造出一种愉悦轻松的氛围。
